text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At Sounds of Earth's request, we came to visit an amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Stupendo!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
An amusement parkâwhat a wonderful "sound"!
Such an utterly giocoso "sound" from all the people!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Trainer!
Let us venture into a fantastico dream together!

text_block_list.name: Haunted House Zombie
text_block_list.text: UGRAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Oddio!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: To think a bloody hand would reach out from the haunted house's shelf! ...G-G-Guh-guh!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Grazie!! What a phenomenal performance!!
You're the ultimate zombie...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Nay! The universe's greatest zombie!!
Perfetto!

text_block_list.name: Haunted House Zombie
text_block_list.text: Ugh... ooga booga~... thank yooou~...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, buono! What exquisitely luscious gelato!
Such a supreme texture, such a melt-in-your-mouth sound..."

text_block_list.name: Ice Cream Vendor
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?
I just made it like I always do, though...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Masterful skill translated into love for the guests!
Con amore!

text_block_list.name: Ice Cream Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Aww...! You sure know what to say to make me happy...!
Let me add another scoop of ice cream on top!!

text_block_list.name: Impatient Woman
text_block_list.text: Jeez! The line for this attraction is way too long! How much longer do they expect us to wait?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Now, now, signorina! A frown will only cast a shadow over such a lovely face!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
We had nothing better to do while waiting, you see.
I was just hoping to admire some lovely flowers!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Please, most deliciously...
Allow me to adore the elegant flower that you are!

text_block_list.name: Impatient Woman
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?
I'm elegante and delizioso?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "That's right! Salute to your eyes!"
choice_data_list: Y-You even cheered up the big sis!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sounds of Earth enjoyed the amusement park
while serenading everyone he met—

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Dear guests...
The park is now closed for today."

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to the day
I can meet you all again from the bottom of my heart."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. Sweet moments always pass in the blink of an eye...
Prestissimo!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Still... it's far too early for the finale.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
There's just one special program left waiting at the very end.
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: A special session, just the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"You've been playing it all along, haven't you?
Right beside me—such a fantastico sound!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Let's play musica of joy and wonder!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A melodia that makes my heart dance with joy
no matter the time!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Because you played such a wonderful 'sound'—
I just felt like closing out today with a session for just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you like to gaze at the stars on a scenic hill...
and chat about how much fun we had today?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A sweet, special musica just for the two of us.
And a bellissimo starry sky stretching out to infinity...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us take a secret detour together.
The beautiful stage of the night is just beginning!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her special, whispered sweet nothings just for me made my head spin a little...!
choice_data_list: Still, staying up late will affect tomorrow!
Well, if it's just that much...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...! Well, well!
Even amid the sweet melody, your own tune rings out powerfully!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I have been completely captivated
by the "sound" that is you this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though I managed to withstand his sweet seduction, it became an unforgettable day that reminded me of Sounds of Earth's irresistible charm.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Allow me to guide you then... my cute Angelo!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's right here—how is it?
You can hear the nighttime melodia clearly, right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Every single moment of today shines against the pitch-black sky...
Ah, it is grazioso beyond measure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Sounds of Earth and I looked back
on the fun time we spent at the amusement park,
making it a deeply memorable night.
